## Combining text and variables for dynamic labels

Say we want to create a sentence that says

> The maximum number of attendances was 20000 

(or whatever it is)

we can create join a string together with the `paste0()` command

```{r}
library(NHSRdatasets)

data <- NHSRdatasets::ae_attendances

paste0('The maximum number of attendances was ', max(data$attendances))
```

## you can make longer strings and switch between text and non text with commas

```{r}
paste0(
  'The maximum number of attendances was ',
  max(data$attendances),
  ' and the lowest was ',
  min(data$attendances)
)
```

## `glue` package

The `glue` package has functions that are easier to use and to read than paste

```{r}
library(glue)

max_attend <- max(data$attendances)
min_attend <- min(data$attendances)

glue(
  'The maximum number of attendances was {max_attend} and the lowest was {min_attend}'
)
```

This does the same with with considerably fewer brackets and commas
